visualSweep.bc: All 12 pages: cover 1, B 2–4, C 5–8, explicit blanks 9–11, back cover 12.
visualSweep.scheme: All 42 pages: cover 1, guidance/rubrics 2–5, A 6–10, B 11–17, C 18–30, separate food-studies coursework 31–40, blank 41, back cover 42. Coursework is a separate assessment, not a task in these written-paper booklets.

foam.note: Whisking mechanically unfolds proteins around air bubbles; subsequent heating sets the foam. Whisking does not need to generate cooking heat, as the scheme suggests.

ombudsman.note: The Office of the Ombudsman deals with public services. Its remit excludes banks, insurance companies and An Post, despite their inclusion in the historical scheme.

green-dot.note: The symbol indicates financial participation in packaging recovery; it does not itself certify recyclability or recycled content.

ecolabel.note: The EU Ecolabel concerns compliance with product-category environmental criteria assessed across the life cycle, not zero environmental impact.

sectionAReview.selectionDecisions: Q1, Q3 and Q6 each have two independent printed prompts and published tariffs. The required digestion table, packaging, additives, income terms and symbol pair remain whole tasks. Q8/Q11 are open named profiles and Q12 is a dependent comparison of the two named insurance types.

tooth-decay.note: Tooth decay is driven by acids produced by oral bacteria acting on sugars/starches, not simply vitamin D deficiency.

vitamin-d-stability.note: Vitamin D retention varies with food and processing conditions; the source’s absolute claim that it is unaffected by cooking is inaccurate.

marriage-notification.note: Notification goes to the civil registration service for religious as well as civil/secular marriages, not solely to a church.

marriage-age.note: Minimum age is 18, not strictly over 18; previous age-exemption provisions were repealed.

mould.note: Growth and heat-resistance conditions vary by organism and food; source temperatures/timings are historical examples, not validated universal safety limits.

sectionBReview.selectionDecisions: B1 chart is one open four-point response. Required vitamin headings stay together. Vegan diet uses three open paired nutrient/strategy slots. Alternative protein food and mould are whole open profiles, with every published model route and a further valid choice. B5(c) has two independent prompts and tariffs; reasons/procedure split. The existing mould ID retains progress while recovering all eleven omitted name/characteristic marks.

solar.note: Solar systems capture sunlight, not wind/rain energy; hot water supply is variable and does not cover every demand without backup.

insulation.note: Bulk insulation slows heat flow; reflective barriers are a distinct treatment for radiant transfer.

texturing.note: Filament yarn can be texturised for bulk/appearance. The historical scheme uses filament modification broadly and includes fabric finishes.

canning.note: Low-acid vegetables require a validated pressure-canning process. Short examination examples are not complete preservation recipes.

irradiation.note: Enzyme inactivation is not guaranteed by every irradiation treatment; the IAEA source describes blanching before irradiation for enzyme control.

resistance-heating.note: Electrical resistance converts electrical energy into thermal energy; conduction and convection describe subsequent heat transfer.

sectionCReview.selectionDecisions: Required floor-covering headings form one recommendation; the duplicate half becomes a progress alias. Filament modification is one explanation illustrated by two examples. Open profiles and required headings remain whole.

boundaryDecisions: A1/A3/A6 each have separate printed prompts at independent 4+2 tariffs.
B3(b) is one open mould profile: name 2, characteristics 9, conditions 12. Restored all eleven missing marks on the old conditions ID.
B5(c) reasons 4 and procedure 10 are independent prompts.

C1(a)(ii) is one floor-covering recommendation under required headings. The name/properties half is withdrawn onto an explicit progress alias; all nine model floor types and further accepted alternatives remain available.
C2(b)(ii) remains one explanation illustrated by two examples; its source uses filament modification broadly and the distinction from fabric finishing is explained.
C3(b)(ii) is one open choice of two facilities, with two separate nine-mark marking groups.
Whole-sitting A/B/C choice instructions do not create combination cards. All question-level selection directives are pinned from raw paper regions; changes fail authoring.

completion.notes: All 23 final paper/scheme anchor pairs visually checked after generation. All required table continuations, original figures and final question marks retained. Three source-image crops independently checked. No coverage or frozen preservation baseline reset.
